    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    List<RecruitmentCourse>
    AllocationService.autoAllocate(Recruitment recruitment)
    Overwrites every non-removed section's allocation with a best effort at the hiring target from the enrollment estimates, and returns the sections in page order: each section gets its unrounded share rounded to the nearest whole number (half up); while the total is above the target, the section furthest above its share (the largest allocation - unroundedAllocation) loses one; while the total is below the target, the section furthest below its share gains one.
    List<RecruitmentCourse>
    AllocationService.recompute(Recruitment recruitment)
    Recomputes and stores unroundedAllocation for every non-removed section of the recruitment: totalHiringTarget * estimate / total of the estimates, or 0.0 for every section when the estimates add up to nothing.
